selection_rule: Prefer dev grounded-answer mean, then context evidence rate, then Evidence Hit@3; use cost/time to resolve ties. Inspect abstention and false abstention before freezing.

trials.name: dense_baseline
trials.hypothesis: Day06 dense index without context expansion is the baseline.

trials.name: bm25
trials.hypothesis: Lexical matches may recover terms and statistics missed by dense retrieval.

trials.name: hybrid
trials.hypothesis: RRF may combine complementary dense and lexical evidence.

trials.name: hybrid_neighbors1
trials.hypothesis: One same-page neighbor on each side may restore definitions cut by 300-character windows.

trials.name: hybrid_neighbors2
trials.hypothesis: Wider context may recover long qualifications, at the risk of crowding out other seeds.
